soldier: Head pale yellow, antennae paler, labrum darker, mandibles bright brown; thorax and abdomen white with a yellowish tinge. Head capsule rectangular and slightly elongate, head-width index 0.54–0.6, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin nearly straight. Frontal peaks raised. Labrum ligulate, the semi-transparent apex broadly and roundly projecting, apical, lateral apical and subapical setae all rather distinct. Mandibles rather slender and straight, shorter than the head width but more than half the head capsule length. About 9 setae along the margin of the lacinia. Postmentum slightly broad, waist constriction index 0.31–0.37, the ratio of the narrowest part to the head width about 1:7 and to the postmental length about 1:7.9 to 1:9.8. Antennae 15–16 segments. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum almost straight, lateral margins sloping posteriorly, anterior margin with a shallow U-shaped concavity in the middle, posterior margin slightly concave forwards, median emargination index about 13%. Setae in the middle region of the thoracic tergites: about 30 or more on each of the pronotum and mesonotum, about 20 on the metanotum.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
